en.headline: Driver arrested for drink-driving after crashing into Ma On Shan railing
en.dek: A 33-year-old man failed a breath test after his private car struck a roadside barrier near a police station on Saturday morning.
body: A 33-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of drink-driving after his private car crashed into a roadside railing in Ma On Shan on Saturday morning.

Police said the incident occurred at about 8.20am when the car was travelling along Ma On Shan Road and turning into Kam Ying Road. The vehicle struck and damaged about 1.5 metres of railing. Officers attending the scene detected alcohol on the driver’s breath.
The man, surnamed Wong, failed a preliminary breath test and was arrested. He was detained for further investigation. No other injuries were reported.
Police reminded motorists that drink-driving carries serious penalties, including fines, imprisonment and driving disqualification.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山私家車撞欄 33歲司機涉醉駕被捕
zh.dek: 車輛於早上失控撞毀約1.5米欄杆，司機未能通過酒精呼氣測試，現正被扣留調查。
body: 馬鞍山周六早上發生交通意外，一輛私家車撞向路邊欄杆，33歲男司機涉嫌酒後駕駛被捕。
警方指，約上午8時20分，私家車沿馬鞍山路行駛，右轉入錦英路時失控，撞毀路邊約1.5米欄杆。警員到場發現姓黃司機身上有酒氣。
黃男未能通過初步酒精呼氣測試，涉嫌酒後駕駛被捕，現正被扣留調查。意外中無人受傷。
警方提醒司機切勿酒後駕駛，一經定罪可被判罰款、監禁及停牌。
